item.title: U.S. military says it shot down Iranian drones launched toward Gulf allies
item.description: The exchange of strikes comes as the Trump administration ramps up pressure on Iran to make a deal to end the conflict.

item.title: A park famed for rare gorillas gears up to fight Ebola and protect its primates
item.description: In Virunga National Park, rangers are on the frontlines — playing a critical role to contain the surging virus while coping with an upsurge in conflict-related violence.
